create or alter procedure [graph].[UpdateGraphTableHierarchyBy] @executionId uniqueidentifier = null, @assetTypeId int = null, @assetId bigint = null as begin set nocount on;
drop table if exists #hierarchy drop table if exists #tbl drop table if exists #incoming drop table if exists #ids drop table if exists #tblgrp
create table #hierarchy ( GroupID bigint, AssetTypeID int, ID bigint, [Level] int, ParentID bigint, Code nvarchar(250) )
create table #tbl ( GroupID bigint, AssetTypeID int,
ID bigint, [Level] int, [Position] decimal(5,3),
ParentID bigint, ParentLevel int, ParentPosition decimal(5,3),
ColumnOrder int, FormattedValue nvarchar(max) )
create table #incoming (ID bigint)
create table #ids (GroupID bigint, ID bigint, ParentID bigint, [Path] nvarchar(2500), Segments xml)
if @executionId is not null begin declare @assetTypeUid uniqueidentifier select top 1 @assetTypeUid = F.AssetTypeUid from api.Execution E cross apply openjson(E.Fields, N'lax $') with (AssetTypeUid uniqueidentifier) F where E.ExecutionID = @executionId
if @assetTypeUid is not null begin insert into #incoming select AssetID from api.ExecutionAsset where ExecutionID = @executionId and UpdateGraph = 1; end end else if @assetTypeId is not null begin insert into #incoming select ID from Asset where AssetTypeID = @assetTypeId; end else if @assetId is not null begin insert into #incoming values (@assetId); end
if exists (select top 1 * from #incoming) begin with descendants as ( select I.Subject, I.SubjectID, I.Object, I.ObjectID, C.ID from #incoming O inner join Asset A on O.ID = A.ID inner join PredicateIntersect I on I.PredicateType in (3,4) and I.Subject = A.Object and I.SubjectID = A.ObjectID inner join Asset C on C.Object = I.Object and C.ObjectID = I.ObjectID union all select I.Subject, I.SubjectID, I.Object, I.ObjectID, A.ID from descendants c inner join PredicateIntersect I on I.PredicateType in (3,4) and I.Subject = c.Object and I.SubjectID = c.ObjectID inner join Asset A on A.Object = I.Object and A.ObjectID = I.ObjectID ) insert into #incoming select ID from descendants;
select top 1 @assetId = ID from #incoming
create clustered index CIX_TempIncoming on #incoming (ID)
declare @class int select top 1 @class = T.Class from Asset A inner join AssetType T on T.ID = A.AssetTypeID and A.ID = @assetId;
if @class = 15 --diagram asset, we need to go through a different relationship. begin with hierarchy as ( select DA.ID as GroupID, DA.AssetTypeID, DA.ID, DA.Object, DA.ObjectID, A.Object as ParentObject, A.ObjectID as ParentObjectID, DA.Code, 0 as [Level] from Asset A inner join AssetProcessDiagram D on D.AssetID = A.ID cross apply openjson(D.Diagram, '$.nodeDataArray') with (assetUid uniqueidentifier N'$.key') N inner join Asset DA on DA.Uid = N.assetUid inner join #incoming O on O.ID = DA.ID union all select c.GroupID, A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, A.Object, A.ObjectID, I.Subject as ParentObject, I.SubjectID as ParentObjectID, A.Code, c.[Level]-1 as [Level] from hierarchy c inner join Asset A on c.ParentObject = A.Object and c.ParentObjectID = A.ObjectID outer apply ( select I.Subject, I.SubjectID from PredicateIntersect I where I.PredicateType in (3,4) and I.Object = A.Object and I.ObjectID = A.ObjectID ) I )
insert into #hierarchy (GroupID, AssetTypeID, ID, [Level], ParentID, Code) select A.GroupID, A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, A.[Level], P.ID, A.Code from hierarchy A left join Asset P on P.Object = A.ParentObject and P.ObjectID = A.ParentObjectID end else begin with hierarchy as ( select A.ID as GroupID, A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, I.Object, I.ObjectID, I.Subject as ParentObject, I.SubjectID as ParentObjectID, A.Code, 0 as [Level] from Asset A left join PredicateIntersect I on I.PredicateType in (3,4) and I.Object = A.Object and I.ObjectID = A.ObjectID inner join #incoming O on O.ID = A.ID union all select c.GroupID, A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, A.Object, A.ObjectID, I.Subject as ParentObject, I.SubjectID as ParentObjectID, A.Code, c.[Level]-1 as [Level] from hierarchy c inner join Asset A on c.ParentObject = A.Object and c.ParentObjectID = A.ObjectID outer apply ( select I.Subject, I.SubjectID from PredicateIntersect I where I.PredicateType in (3,4) and I.Object = A.Object and I.ObjectID = A.ObjectID ) I )
insert into #hierarchy (GroupID, AssetTypeID, ID, [Level], ParentID, Code) select A.GroupID, A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, A.[Level], P.ID, A.Code from hierarchy A left join Asset P on P.Object = A.ParentObject and P.ObjectID = A.ParentObjectID end
if @class = 9 begin insert into #tbl (GroupID, AssetTypeID, ID, [Level], [Position], ParentID, ParentLevel, ColumnOrder, FormattedValue) select GroupID, AssetTypeID, ID, [Level], cast(cast([Level] as varchar) + '.1' as decimal(5,3)) as Position, ParentID, [Level] - 1, 1, Code from #hierarchy end else if @class = 11 begin create nonclustered index CIX_TempHierarchy on #hierarchy (ID)
insert into #tbl (GroupID, AssetTypeID, ID, [Level], [Position], ParentID, ParentLevel, ColumnOrder, FormattedValue) select GroupID, H.AssetTypeID, H.ID, [Level], cast(cast([Level] as varchar) + '.1' as decimal(5,3)) as Position, H.ParentID, [Level] - 1, 1, F.FirstName + ' ' + F.LastName from #hierarchy H inner join Asset A on A.ID = H.ID and A.Object = 'Resource' inner join reporting.Global_Resource F on F.ResourceID = A.ObjectID end else if @class = 12 begin create nonclustered index CIX_TempHierarchy on #hierarchy (ID)
insert into #tbl (GroupID, AssetTypeID, ID, [Level], [Position], ParentID, ParentLevel, ColumnOrder, FormattedValue) select GroupID, H.AssetTypeID, H.ID, [Level], cast(cast([Level] as varchar) + '.1' as decimal(5,3)) as Position, H.ParentID, [Level] - 1, 1, F.Name from #hierarchy H inner join Asset A on A.ID = H.ID and A.Object = 'Group' inner join dbo.[Group] F on F.ID = A.ObjectID end else begin create nonclustered index CIX_TempHierarchy on #hierarchy (AssetTypeID)
insert into #tbl (GroupID, AssetTypeID, ID, [Level], [Position], ParentID, ParentLevel, ColumnOrder, FormattedValue) select distinct A.GroupID, A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, A.[Level], cast(cast(A.[Level] as varchar) + '.' + cast(FT.ColumnOrder as varchar) as decimal(5,3)) as Position, A.ParentID, A.[Level] - 1, FT.ColumnOrder, F.FormattedValue from #hierarchy A inner join FieldType FT on FT.AssetTypeID = A.AssetTypeID and FT.IsPartOfKey = 1 inner join Field F on F.FieldTypeID = FT.ID and F.AssetID = A.ID
--handle counter fields insert into #tbl (GroupID, AssetTypeID, ID, [Level], [Position], ParentID, ParentLevel, ColumnOrder, FormattedValue) select distinct A.GroupID, A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, A.[Level], cast(cast(A.[Level] as varchar) + '.' + cast(FT.ColumnOrder as varchar) as decimal(5,3)) as Position, A.ParentID, A.[Level] - 1, FT.ColumnOrder, coalesce(FT.CounterPrefix,'')+ cast(FCV.Value as nvarchar(20)) as FormattedValue from #hierarchy A inner join FieldType FT on FT.AssetTypeID = A.AssetTypeID and FT.IsPartOfKey = 1 and FT.Type = 'Counter' inner join FieldCounterValue FCV on FCV.AssetId = A.Id and FCV.FieldTypeId = FT.Id end
create clustered index CIX_TempTbl on #tbl (GroupID)
if exists (select 1 from #tbl where [Level] < 1) begin update T set [Level] = [Level] + S.[LevelUp], [ParentLevel] = [ParentLevel] + S.[LevelUp] from #tbl T cross apply ( select abs(min([Level]))+1 as [LevelUp] from #tbl where GroupID = T.GroupID ) S end
insert into #ids (GroupID, ID, ParentID) select GroupID, ID, ParentID from #tbl group by GroupID, ID, ParentID;
create nonclustered index CIX_TempIds on #ids (ID,GroupID)
select s.groupid,(select t.[Level] as '@level', t.ColumnOrder as '@position', t.AssetTypeID as '@assetTypeId', t.ID as '@assetId', t.FormattedValue as 'data()' from #tbl t where t.GroupID = S.GroupID order by t.Position for xml path('segment'), root('path')) XMLData into #tblgrp from #tbl s group by s.groupid;
create nonclustered index CIX_tblgrp on #tblgrp (GroupID)
--Update the graph table. update T set T.Segments = ( select g.XMLData from #tblgrp g where g.GroupID = S.GroupID ) from graph.AssetNode T inner join #ids S on S.ID = T.ID and S.GroupID = S.ID;
--Queue Search index updates to path, except when this procedure is called for an entire asset type if @assetTypeId is null begin insert into [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID],[AssetID]) select 'ObjectIndex', 'Path', a.Object, a.ObjectID, S.ID FROM [dbo].[asset] a inner join #ids S on S.ID = a.ID and S.GroupID = S.ID; end end end
